quotes.name: Q, Stacking the Deck
quotes.flavor: "Games? Did someone say games?"

quotes.name: Skystrike Officer
quotes.flavor: "Landing zone is clear. Activate and deploy!"

quotes.name: Stampede
quotes.flavor:
"When are beasts like a river?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

quotes.name: Aetherjacket
quotes.flavor: The Sting Strike model saved thousands of lives during the Invasion and quickly became a bestseller for Shadowblayde Craftworks.

quotes.name: Hide on the Ceiling
quotes.flavor:
"Peter? Is that you? I could have sworn I heard that boy moving around up here."
—Aunt May

quotes.name: Take Heart
quotes.flavor: In the quiet before a battle, Boros soldiers whisper prayers that steady their nerves and focus their minds.

quotes.name: Jacob Hauken, Inspector // Hauken's Insight
quotes.flavor: "Our world may be dark, but there's still plenty to see."

quotes.name: Heartstone
quotes.flavor:
"Finding a true heartstone is even harder than finding a true heart."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Screeching Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"What wears down my people most, I think, is not the danger, but the endless screeching outside our camp."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

quotes.name: Rebellious Captives
quotes.flavor: "The Fire Nation will regret the day they set foot on our land!"

quotes.name: Mardu Hordechief
quotes.flavor: The horde grows with each assault.

quotes.name: Magus of the Bridge
quotes.flavor: "The dead know their place."

quotes.name: Stitcher's Supplier
quotes.flavor: No part goes to waste.

quotes.name: Primal Might
quotes.flavor: The shaman looked at the world through Ghalta's eyes and understood that everything else was his prey.

quotes.name: Imperiosaur
quotes.flavor:
"An ancient, powerful force has overtaken the valley. I sympathize for its former inhabitants, but I rejoice for the land itself."
—Olanti, Muraganda druid

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: Occasionally members of the Institute of Arcane Study acquire a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

quotes.name: Phantom Warrior
quotes.flavor: The phantom warrior comes from nowhere and returns there just as quickly.

quotes.name: Clawing Torment
quotes.flavor: A kami's anger never fades, never sleeps, never loosens its grasp.

quotes.name: Fortifying Draught
quotes.flavor: "If a seedling can push through solid stone, there's no limit to what I could do."

quotes.name: Giant Cindermaw
quotes.flavor:
"Don't excavate too far into those canyons. I promised your parents I'd return you in one piece."
—Tocasia

quotes.name: Teferi's Protection
quotes.flavor:
"Someday, when the world is safe again, my homeland will return."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Iona, Shield of Emeria
quotes.flavor: No more shall the righteous cower before evil.

quotes.name: Wall of Blossoms
quotes.flavor: Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.

quotes.name: Aether Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Virtue's Ruin
quotes.flavor: All must fall, and those who stand highest fall hardest.

quotes.name: Nettle Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Though Shadowmoor's monster-haunted wilds beckon, she never leaves her post.

quotes.name: Vedalken Entrancer
quotes.flavor: Their denial reaches far into your future.

quotes.name: Minotaur Explorer
quotes.flavor: After the invasion devastated the Talruum and Hurloon tribes, the survivors began to search for other minotaurs.

quotes.name: Carnage Tyrant
quotes.flavor: Sun Empire commanders are well versed in advanced martial strategy. Still, the correct maneuver is usually to deploy the giant, implacable death lizard.

quotes.name: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime
quotes.flavor: "The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not."

quotes.name: Release the Gremlins
quotes.flavor:
"Being an inventor means knowing how to use the tools at hand to make something great—or to bring it down."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Thwip!
quotes.flavor: "Yes! This is what being Spider-Man is all about! Swinging through the sky—a New York sky—patrolling the city. Every moment a chance to make a difference. To fight the good fight."

quotes.name: Sleep Paralysis
quotes.flavor: Sleep doesn't always mean rest.

quotes.name: Summon: Primal Odin
quotes.flavor: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

quotes.name: Threads of Disloyalty
quotes.flavor:
"Over time, Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Jade Statue
quotes.flavor:
"Some of the other guys dared me to touch it, but I knew it weren't no ordinary hunk o' rock."
—Norin the Wary

quotes.name: Thran Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"What we do not use up, we use again."
—Urza

quotes.name: Vodalian Hexcatcher
quotes.flavor: "You're just one more pollutant to be removed from the sea."

quotes.name: Peer Past the Veil
quotes.flavor: Those who glimpse the House's true nature firsthand are cursed to never again look away.

quotes.name: Welcoming Vampire
quotes.flavor: From the moment they arrived, wedding guests were met with a pageant of wealth and excess.

quotes.name: Thorn of the Black Rose
quotes.flavor: If bribery and intimidation fail, Marchesa turns to her favorite form of persuasion.

quotes.name: Krark-Clan Stoker
quotes.flavor: Fallen enemies are fed to the scavengers. Fallen friends are thrown into the Great Furnace, their souls returned to the Great Mother.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"We have barely begun to learn the secrets of the Fourth People. Every remnant of their presence, however cryptic, is a gift."
—Akal Pakal, First Steward of Oteclan

quotes.name: Spitemare
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor:
"I knew a creature carved from a dream of wild freedom. Any attempt to leash or exploit it failed, and at terrible cost."
—Ashling

quotes.name: Body Double
quotes.flavor: "I am who I pretend to be."

quotes.name: Plague Myr
quotes.flavor: They watch for a new master, one more sinister than the last.

quotes.name: Howling Banshee
quotes.flavor:
"No such thing as 'too quiet.' Quiet is good. Quiet means we don't end up dead in the mud, bleeding from our ears."
—Rem Karolus

quotes.name: Woolly Thoctar
quotes.flavor: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

quotes.name: Frilled Sandwalla
quotes.flavor:
"Even the smallest creatures are fierce in defense of their own territory."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Lurking Green Dragon
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Territorial. Scary. No further notes."
—Volo's field notes

quotes.name: Casualties of War
quotes.flavor: War... war never changes.

quotes.name: Sandwurm Convergence
quotes.flavor: Cantankerous and territorial, sandwurms claim even the skies above their dunes.

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Will of the Naga
quotes.flavor: The charm of a naga is undeniable.

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor: The squad plunged deep into Hive Pandorial, finding only the shambling corpses of those they came to avenge.

quotes.name: Enfeeblement
quotes.flavor: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*. As the battle raged on deck, he felt his strength melt in the heat of her betrayal.

quotes.name: Heir of the Ancient Fang
quotes.flavor: On the last day of a Jukai agent's training, they are bequeathed a powerful relic blessed by the kami.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Archivist
quotes.flavor: Silence quickly went from an annoying library rule to an imperative for survival.

quotes.name: Wrath of Marit Lage
quotes.flavor:
"Marit Lage lies frozen in a glacier's heart. Still her dreams take form in our world, stealing the heat from our souls."
—Halvor Arenson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Kithkin Harbinger
quotes.flavor: Her ears are open to even the softest voice.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Forces
quotes.flavor: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

quotes.name: Bolt Bend
quotes.flavor:
"Give them everything you've got . . . and some things you don't."
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Tar Pitcher
quotes.flavor:
"Auntie Grub had caught a goat, a bleating doe that still squirmed in her arms. At the same time, her warren decided to share with her a sensory greeting of hot tar . . . ."
—A tale of Auntie Grub

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor:
"Peace hath her victories / No less renownd than war."
—John Milton, "To the Lord General Cromwell"

quotes.name: Temur Sabertooth
quotes.flavor: The Temur see themselves as a pack, their bonds more primal than the Abzan's.

quotes.name: Goblin Wizardry
quotes.flavor: "Quiet in the library" soon gave way to larger concerns.

quotes.name: Non-Human Cannonball
quotes.flavor: Designed for maximum impact, comedic and otherwise.

quotes.name: Royal Assassin
quotes.flavor: An assassin is a king's most trusted courier, ensuring his messages are heard by even the most unwilling recipients.

quotes.name: Cinder Storm
quotes.flavor: When the sky's rain has turned to fire, what will put it out?

quotes.name: Secure the Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Concentrate
quotes.flavor: "The treasure in my mind is greater than any worldly glory."

quotes.name: Orcish Artillery
quotes.flavor: In a rare display of ingenuity, the Orcs invented an incredibly destructive weapon. Most Orcish artillerists are those who dared criticize its effectiveness.

quotes.name: Stranglehold
quotes.flavor: The correct answer to a barbarian's riddle is to choke on your cleverness and die.

quotes.name: Clergy en-Vec
quotes.flavor:
"Faith's shield is hammered out by the blows of unbelievers."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Willow Geist
quotes.flavor: Die beneath a tree, wake up a part of it.

quotes.name: Heartbeat of Spring
quotes.flavor:
"It is true that we monks hold the key to paradise, but most don't understand that the paradise we guard is the one within."
—Diary of Azusa

quotes.name: Tradewind Rider
quotes.flavor: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.

quotes.name: Hellion Eruption
quotes.flavor: Just when you thought you'd be safe, in the middle of an open field with no Eldrazi around for miles.

quotes.name: Phantom Warrior
quotes.flavor:
"The construction of a defense is not accomplished by adding bricks."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Rancor
quotes.flavor: Hatred outlives the hateful.

quotes.name: Decision Paralysis
quotes.flavor:
"Eyes see only what is possible. A trained mind can explore the impossible."
—Kefnet, god of knowledge

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Her sword sings more beautifully than any choir.

quotes.name: Deathbloom Ritualist
quotes.flavor: Each fallen friend was a seed of regret, eager to blossom again in Gaea's name.

quotes.name: Gleam of Battle
quotes.flavor: Every soldier returns from battle changed: by hardship, by blood, by a glimpse of glory.

quotes.name: Kingpin's Pet
quotes.flavor:
"Debt and death sound so similar, and thrulls are so hard of hearing. Mistakes are inevitable."
—Milana, Orzhov prelate

quotes.name: Jace's Ingenuity
quotes.flavor: "Brute force can sometimes kick down a locked door, but knowledge is a skeleton key."

quotes.name: Sunlance
quotes.flavor:
"It's easy for the innocent to speak of justice. They seldom feel its terrible power."
—Orim, Samite inquisitor

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.set_name: Premium Deck Series: Fire and Lightning
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Wand of the Worldsoul
quotes.flavor:
"May Mat'Selesnya bind our hearts as one."
—Selesnya prayer

quotes.name: Serene Steward
quotes.flavor: "I can give you strength, but you'll have to bring your own courage."

quotes.name: Thunder-Thrash Elder
quotes.flavor: Viashino thrashes are led by elders who have survived countless challenges.

quotes.name: Whispers of the Muse
quotes.flavor:
"I followed her song only to find it was a dirge."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Court of Ambition
quotes.flavor: Watch your step.

quotes.name: Taunting Elf
quotes.flavor: The safety of the village depends on the beast thinking with its stomach.

quotes.name: Ponder
quotes.flavor: Tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.

quotes.name: Enthusiastic Study
quotes.flavor: "If the pen is mightier than the sword, just think what a giant tome could do!"

quotes.name: Embraal Gear-Smasher
quotes.flavor: "A well-made wrench is a versatile, indispensable tool."

quotes.name: Serpent of the Pass
quotes.flavor: Those who walk the Serpent's Pass quickly discover the origin of its name.

quotes.name: Bog Rats
quotes.flavor: Their stench was vile and strong enough, but not nearly as powerful as their hunger.

quotes.name: Aberrant Return
quotes.flavor: Shadowmoor is rife with wild magic—powerful but as volatile as the plane itself.

quotes.name: Big Score
quotes.flavor:
"It's theorized that all the iridium in our world comes from meteorites..."
—Maru

quotes.name: Haunted Fengraf
quotes.flavor: A ghoulcaller's playground.

quotes.name: Divide by Zero
quotes.flavor: "Misery. Inadequacy. Failure. The common denominator is you."

quotes.name: Sylvan Ranger
quotes.flavor: "Not all paths are found on the forest floor."

quotes.name: Tormod's Crypt
quotes.flavor: Dominaria's most extravagant crypt nevertheless holds an empty grave.

quotes.name: Strix Serenade
quotes.flavor: Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.

quotes.name: Malamet Veteran
quotes.flavor: The mightiest Malamet warriors train as titan-killers, elite champions capable of facing down the caverns' most fearsome beasts.

quotes.name: Kamahl, Pit Fighter
quotes.flavor: In times when freedom seems lost, great souls arise to reclaim it.

quotes.name: Avalanche Tusker
quotes.flavor:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy"
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

quotes.name: Deranged Assistant
quotes.flavor: "Garl, adjust the slurry dispensers. Garl, fetch more corpses. Garl, quit crying and give me your brain tissue. If he doesn't stop being so rude, I'm quitting."

quotes.name: Durkwood Boars
quotes.flavor:
"And the unclean spirits went out, and entered the swine: and the herd ran violently . . . ."
—*The Bible*, Mark 5:13

quotes.name: Lady Evangela
quotes.flavor:
"When milady was young, the sight of a rainbow would fill her soul with peace. As she grew, she learned to share her rapture with others."
—Lady Gabriella

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

quotes.name: Fervent Champion
quotes.flavor: 2018 World Champion Javier Dominguez

quotes.name: Narset's Reversal
quotes.flavor: "For every problem, a thousand answers. For every answer, a thousand branching consequences."

quotes.name: Tangled Florahedron // Tangled Vale
quotes.flavor:
"We would do well to open our eyes and remember what it is to wonder."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

quotes.name: Unexpected Windfall
quotes.flavor:
"As far back as I can remember, I've been living here on this dark island, always guarding the Master Emerald from anything that can harm it."
—Knuckles the Echidna

quotes.name: Loch Korrigan
quotes.flavor:
"Don't look upon still waters without first breaking the surface. The korrigan will catch you with her gaze and drag you to your death."
—Kithkin superstition

quotes.name: Arms Dealer
quotes.flavor: He has the weapons, he has the connections, and he knows the hangar's dark secret.

quotes.name: Arcane Endeavor
quotes.flavor: Late at night, when dreams touch a studious mind, bouts of inspiration strike.

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor: The Fort served as Caesar's base of operations. From here, the Legion dreamed of transforming themselves from nomads to an empire.

quotes.name: Lhurgoyf
quotes.flavor:
"Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"
—Saffi Eriksdotter, last words

quotes.name: Timberland Guide
quotes.flavor: Hiring an experienced wilderness guide isn't cheap, but it costs less than a search party. Or a funeral.

quotes.name: Angel of Mercy
quotes.flavor: A song of life soars over fields of blood.

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Silkenfist Order
Aether Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Release that which was never caged."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elves
quotes.flavor: "We could no more abandon the forest than the stars could abandon the night sky."

quotes.name: Orah, Skyclave Hierophant
quotes.flavor: "The Skyclaves are our inheritance."

quotes.name: Brineborn Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "I always attack from where their spyglasses can't see."

quotes.name: Bursting Beebles
quotes.flavor: Like thousands of others, the beebles quit Magic for several years following the release of the *Mercadian Masques* set.

quotes.name: Enhanced Surveillance
quotes.flavor:
"Who are the agents of the Dimir? No one and everyone."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: WITNESS ME AS I WITNESS YOU

quotes.name: Platoon Dispenser
quotes.flavor:
"Hear that thud-clank, thud-clank? We're saved."
—Ani, Urzan soldier

quotes.name: Crystal Barricade
quotes.flavor:
"Good as new!"
—Krek, daysquad captain

quotes.name: Reconstruct History
quotes.flavor: ANIMUS INITIALIZING . . . LOADING MEMORY SEQUENCE.

quotes.name: Morkrut Banshee
quotes.flavor: She wails for those who have died, and for those who are about to.

quotes.name: Delivery Moogle
quotes.flavor: "A new letter has arrived just for you, kupo!"

quotes.name: Naya Panorama
quotes.flavor: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

quotes.name: Silver Myr
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: The myr are like quicksilver: malleable in function and adaptable in form.

quotes.name: Secure the Wastes
quotes.flavor:
"The Shifting Wastes provide our clan eternal protection. It is our duty to return the favor."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Grazing Gladehart
quotes.flavor:
"Don't be fooled. If it were as docile as it looks, it would've died off long ago."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

quotes.name: Icatian Town
quotes.flavor: Icatia's once-peaceful towns faced increasing attacks from orcs and goblins as the climate cooled. By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

quotes.name: Wisdom of Ages
quotes.flavor:
"If you take the time to listen, the archaics will tell you that this world has been torn asunder and remade many times before."
—Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios

quotes.name: Brazen Freebooter
quotes.flavor: Finders, keepers.

quotes.name: Dwarven Pony
quotes.flavor:
"I hear Halina's got a pony that can count to six—and likes to eat meat."
—Chandler

quotes.name: Dimensional Exile
quotes.flavor:
"Never been defeated, huh? Well, you never tangled with a turtle before!"
—Donatello

quotes.name: Chainwhip Cyclops
quotes.flavor:
"You say this Tenth District, not Rubblebelt. But where smash happen, that Rubblebelt. Rubblebelt state of mind."
—Urgdar, cyclops philosopher

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

quotes.name: Battle Mastery
quotes.flavor:
"Boom! Boom! Boots the size of oxcarts, then an axe like a falling sun. Elves scattered. Trees scattered. Even the hills ran for the hills!"
—*Clachan Tales*

quotes.name: Desert Twister
quotes.flavor: Massive, mindless, and imbued with one terrible purpose.

quotes.name: Zuko, Exiled Prince
quotes.flavor: "I want the Avatar. I want my honor, my throne."

quotes.name: Chasm Skulker
quotes.flavor: Designed by Mike Neumann

quotes.name: Court Cleric
quotes.flavor:
"The healers of Bant are second to none. I owe them a great deal for their tutelage."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Plague Stinger
quotes.flavor: It leaves its victims one sting closer to phyresis.

quotes.name: Llanowar Loamspeaker
quotes.flavor: Twigs broken underfoot in Llanowar tend to return the favor.

quotes.name: Sole Performer
quotes.flavor: Elven tap is the official language of three very obnoxious planets.

quotes.name: Dragon Fodder
quotes.flavor: Goblins journey to the sacrificial peaks in pairs so that the rare survivor might be able to relate the details of the other's grisly demise.

quotes.name: Dragon Engine
quotes.flavor: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

quotes.name: Hero of the Winds
quotes.flavor: To tame a griffin is to ride into legend.

quotes.name: Act of Heroism
quotes.flavor:
"On every plane, there are those who run toward danger."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Midnight Guard
quotes.flavor:
"When you're on watch, no noise is harmless and no shadow can be ignored."
—Olgard of the Skiltfolk

quotes.name: Elvish Champion
quotes.flavor:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Skyshroud hymn

quotes.name: Frontier Warmonger
quotes.flavor: She cares little for leaders or loyalties, so long as the battle rages on.

quotes.name: Sparktongue Dragon
quotes.flavor: Fools believe that Kolaghan's brood follows lightning storms. The wise know that it is the other way around.

quotes.name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
quotes.flavor: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

quotes.name: Extremely Slow Zombie
quotes.flavor: . . . iiiiiiinnnn . . .

quotes.name: Territorial Baloth
quotes.flavor: It knows nothing of Eldrazi or Planeswalkers, just that there are new intruders in its territory.

quotes.name: Palace Jailer
quotes.flavor: "I think we all know who really deserves to be locked up in here..."

quotes.name: Glorious Anthem
quotes.flavor:
"North and South meet and angels sing.
Voices resound with a righteous ring."
—"The Ballad of the Paladins"

quotes.name: Ley Druid
quotes.flavor: After years of training, the druid becomes one with nature, drawing power from the land and returning it when needed.

quotes.name: Mark of Fury
quotes.flavor: Many Keldon warriors bear the mark of intentional insanity.

quotes.name: Juggernaut
quotes.flavor: We had taken refuge in a small cave, thinking the entrance was too narrow for it to follow. To our horror, its gigantic head smashed into the mountainside, ripping itself a new entrance.

quotes.name: Looming Hoverguard
quotes.flavor: Although mute, hoverguards get their message across loud and clear.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Abomination
quotes.flavor: Create an illusion so strong that it becomes another's reality, and you can become the master of all.

quotes.name: Maestros Initiate
quotes.flavor:
"How far are you willing to go for your family, cleanblade?"
—Lord Xander

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"Qo'noS is the only place in the quadrant a traveler can sample fifty-one varieties of *gagh*. Watch for *wistan gagh*, matured in *targ* blood."
—*Lawmim Galactopedia*

quotes.name: Staff of the Flame Magus
quotes.flavor: A symbol of passion in indifferent times.

quotes.name: Alaborn Musketeer
quotes.flavor: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

quotes.name: Civic Guildmage
quotes.flavor:
To condemn the innocent you must first condemn yourself.
—Civic Guild maxim

quotes.name: Intangible Virtue
quotes.flavor: In life, they were a motley crew: farmers, lords, cutpurses, priests. In death, they are united in singular, benevolent purpose.

quotes.name: Trickster's Talisman
quotes.flavor: "Lady Luck, smile on me!"

quotes.name: Nightwing Shade
quotes.flavor:
"There is one hour of the night even we do not watch."
—Sedva, captain of the watch

quotes.name: Hermit Druid
quotes.flavor: Seeking the company of plants ensures that your wits will go to seed.

quotes.name: Hulldrifter
quotes.flavor: This car is what dreams are made of.

quotes.name: Well of Lost Dreams
quotes.flavor: Some say the knowledge lost during the Ritual of Rebuking is returned through the well's waters.

quotes.name: Sun-Dappled Celebrant
quotes.flavor: Eirdu's adherents celebrate the sun on cold days and create warmth through spirited dances and revelry.

quotes.name: Kozilek's Predator
quotes.flavor: It's difficult to outwit something that doesn't speak, strategize, or even think.

quotes.name: Rending Volley
quotes.flavor: The sky offers few hiding places.

quotes.name: Overeager Apprentice
quotes.flavor: Slow and steady may not always win the race, but at least it doesn't end up splattered on the walls.

quotes.name: Wanderwine Hub
quotes.flavor: Below the great river, a bustling hub channels the flow of merrow trade.

quotes.name: Seedborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"The land echoes our intentions, and the kami echo the land. We must strive to live in harmony with the world even when it seems to rise against us."
—Diary of Azusa

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor: The old woman murmured, her last words too hoarse, too quiet to understand. The Envoy steeled herself, feebly disguising her grief: "The pilgrimage begins at dawn."

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Savage Twister
quotes.flavor:
"Nature is the ultimate mindless destroyer, capable of power and ferocity no army can match, and the Gruul follow its example."
—Trigori, Azorius senator

quotes.name: Gandalf, Wandering Wizard
quotes.flavor: "May the wind under your wings bear you where the sun sails and the moon walks."

quotes.name: Chill
quotes.flavor:
"Temper, temper"
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Mtenda Griffin
quotes.flavor:
"Unlike Zhalfir, the griffin needs no council to keep harmony among its parts."
—Asmira, Holy Avenger

quotes.name: Mirage Mirror
quotes.flavor:
"I'm Reed Richards. The ultimate Reed Richards. The one who's finally going to solve everything."
—The Maker

quotes.name: Coeurl
quotes.flavor: A lean and limber predator whose whiskers acquire charge from naturally-occurring electric particles in the atmosphere.

quotes.name: Hypnotic Specter
quotes.flavor: "...There was no trace/ Of aught on that illumined face..." —Samuel Coleridge, "Phantom"

quotes.name: Riptide Crab
quotes.flavor: It sleeps with its claws open.

quotes.name: Henge of Ramos
quotes.flavor:
It is the hub. We are the wheel.
—Dryad saying

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"Once I saw a goblin shouting at a thunderstorm. He lost the argument pretty quickly."
—Wandering mage

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.flavor: Every branch a crossroads, every vine a swift steed.

quotes.name: Primal Druid
quotes.flavor: "The power of the woods is only ever borrowed."

quotes.name: Ingenious Skaab
quotes.flavor: Heads and shoulders above the rest.

quotes.name: Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, the Mothercrystal
quotes.flavor: "Show me your strength of will!"

quotes.name: Hymn to Tourach
quotes.flavor: Members of the Order often played the Hymn on instruments made from their victims' bones.

quotes.name: Wrap in Flames
quotes.flavor:
"Our pyromancer's flames may not have killed them, but they bought us the time we needed."
—*The War Diaries*

quotes.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
quotes.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

quotes.name: Patriarch's Bidding
quotes.flavor:
"Family plots are so convenient."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Quag Feast
quotes.flavor: Speedbrood racers are gregarious while not racing, but everyone must eat.

quotes.name: Idyllic Tutor
quotes.flavor: I is for Intelligence. A measure of your overall mental acuity. It affects the number of experience points earned and reduces the number of dud words when hacking terminals.

quotes.name: Minecart Daredevil // Ride the Rails
quotes.flavor: Mines that once rang with the strikes of pickaxes now echo with shouts of reckless glee.

quotes.name: Bonebind Orator
quotes.flavor: A great actor can breathe new life into old material.

quotes.name: Slashing Tiger
quotes.flavor:
"Unless you enter the tiger's lair, you cannot get hold of the tiger's cubs."
—Sun Tzu, Art of War (trans. Giles)

quotes.name: Restoration Gearsmith
quotes.flavor: All she touches turns to well-oiled, delicately calibrated, perfectly balanced gold.

quotes.name: Costume Shop
quotes.flavor: Dressed to the 9/9s.

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor: Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.

quotes.name: Basilisk Collar
quotes.flavor: A mark of companionship, not subservience.

quotes.name: Play with Fire
quotes.flavor: Devils find human dwellings to be oppressively cold, dark, and unburnt.

quotes.name: Subjugator Angel
quotes.flavor: The remnants of Innistrad's corrupted angelic hosts collapsed to form the Flight of Nightmares.

quotes.name: Wind Drake
quotes.flavor: Orim regarded Gerrard coolly. "You are like the drake," she said, her expression unchanging. "It works hard to maintain its position, but to us it seems to glide along effortlessly. You must do the same."

quotes.name: Question Elemental?
quotes.flavor: "What the . . . ?"

quotes.name: Deathcurse Ogre
quotes.flavor: After their worship of oni began, only a few of Kamigawa's ogres remained in the bitter cold of the Tendo Peaks. Most were drawn to the darkness of Takenuma.

quotes.name: Prophetic Prism
quotes.flavor:
"Most dreams reveal but fragments of what you could be. Only nightmares can show you who you truly are."
—Ashiok

quotes.name: Anguished Unmaking
quotes.flavor: The drone called One was an accident of technology, doomed from creation, and the first living being for whom Seven was truly responsible.

quotes.name: Grenzo's Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "Their guards are soft, ready to welcome a sharp dagger."

quotes.name: Vedalken Ghoul
quotes.flavor: For four nights following Ennor's death and the reclaiming of his etherium, its recipients were found slain, the etherium ripped from their bodies.

quotes.name: Shadowcloak Vampire
quotes.flavor: "My favorite guilty pleasure? Are there innocent ones?"

quotes.name: Oblivion Ring
quotes.flavor: A circle of sugar and a word of forbiddance.

quotes.name: Chief Miles O'Brien
quotes.flavor: Engineers on *Galaxy*-class ships might be able to replicate every spare part they need, but away from Federation supply lines, more ingenuity may be required.

quotes.name: The Crafter
quotes.flavor: THE

quotes.name: Blood Money
quotes.flavor: For the patriar class, wealth is in the blood.

quotes.name: Icy Manipulator
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: In fire there is the spark of chaos and destruction, the seed of life. In ice there is perfect tranquility, perfect order, and the silence of death.

quotes.name: Demon's Horn
quotes.flavor: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

quotes.name: Raccoon Rallier
quotes.flavor: "I used to play for family only until I realized I could inspire an entire party with a single note."

quotes.name: Mishra's Workshop
quotes.flavor: 2020 Vintage Champion

quotes.name: Patriar's Seal
quotes.flavor: Only a fool ignores a letter bearing the official mark of a patriar family.

quotes.name: Repurposed Enforcer
quotes.flavor: A face half remembered, a form fit to serve.

quotes.name: Kraken Hatchling
quotes.flavor: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

quotes.name: Ghastly Discovery
quotes.flavor: Korrigans, spirits bound to sources of water, shriek when they come upon their own drowned corpses.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: Used carefully, material has been exposed to the baleful energies of the Warp can be contained to fuel powerful rituals.

quotes.name: Spark of Creativity
quotes.flavor:
"To invent is to rebel."
—Pia Nalaar

quotes.name: Thraben Inspector
quotes.flavor: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

quotes.name: Nissa's Renewal
quotes.flavor: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

quotes.name: Glorybringer
quotes.flavor: What the initiates face in the final trial is completely at Hazoret's discretion.

quotes.name: Death Grasp
quotes.flavor: Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.

quotes.name: Scorn Effigy
quotes.flavor: It remembers every wound it has seen or suffered—and nothing else.

quotes.name: Sumala Sentry
quotes.flavor: The great meditation garden of Sumala was no place for Ravnica's rising crime wave, and he would keep it that way.

quotes.name: Moonshaker Cavalry
quotes.flavor: High King Kenrith's armies followed him into the afterlife, ready to charge at his command.

quotes.name: Become Anonymous
quotes.flavor:
"Walk among the scholars—they're allowed into areas you would be denied."
—Rafiq Kadar

quotes.name: Gaea's Will
quotes.flavor: With every end, a new beginning.

quotes.name: Voice of Victory
quotes.flavor: "Come crackling spear, come beating wing! Come cavalier, come taut bowstring!"

quotes.name: Moat Piranhas
quotes.flavor:
"Come on, it's not even that deep!"
—Gorin the Brazen

quotes.name: Rafiq of the Many
quotes.flavor: Many sigils, one purpose.

quotes.name: Tuskeri Firewalker
quotes.flavor: "Toralf blessed me with fire. I am worthy of Starnheim!"

quotes.name: Zhur-Taa Ancient
quotes.flavor: Many Ravnicans think of nature as orderly groves and elf-tended rot farms. They haven't seen the Gruul wilds.

quotes.name: Hungry Ghoul
quotes.flavor: All at once, the warden realized the string of mysterious escapes was an entirely different problem.

quotes.name: Chromatic Lantern
quotes.flavor: By guild tradition, any puddle of multicolored light on the cobblestones can serve as neutral ground.

quotes.name: Vampire Hexmage
quotes.flavor: When the blood hunt lost its thrill, she looked for less tangible means of domination.

quotes.name: Make a Stand
quotes.flavor: For a moment they stood tall, all fear forgotten.

quotes.name: Pilfer
quotes.flavor: To the merchant, it was nothing more than a few missing trinkets. To Tinybones, it was the greatest heist of all time.

quotes.name: Omen of the Hunt
quotes.flavor: "My time will come, when no road will divide the endless verdure of the trees."

quotes.name: Killer Bees
quotes.flavor: The communal mind produces a savage strategy, yet no one could predict that this vicious crossbreed would unravel the secret of steel.

quotes.name: Coalborn Entity
quotes.flavor: The blacksmith forgot to feed the forge, so the forge fed itself.

quotes.name: Pyre Hound
quotes.flavor: Its growl is the crackling and popping of a wildfire untamed.

quotes.name: Doomed Necromancer
quotes.flavor:
"His sacrifice shall not be forgotten. Now toss his body over there with the others."
—Phage the Untouchable

quotes.name: Woodland Champion
quotes.flavor: "Every footfall on the forest floor is a heartbeat sending strength into my veins."

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: No matter how big the fall is, you're safe as long as you land with both feet.

quotes.name: Alphinaud Leveilleur
quotes.flavor: "We alone can accomplish little, but joined by others, we may yet build a bonfire to carry us heavensward."

quotes.name: Relentless Rats
quotes.flavor: If you nourish them, they grow calamitous.

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Harvesttide Infiltrator // Harvesttide Assailant
quotes.flavor: He was one masked stranger among many. Blending in was child's play.

quotes.name: Mad Ratter
quotes.flavor: "Gather round and tell me all from the courts and castles."

quotes.name: White Glove Gourmand
quotes.flavor: "Here's to us! It's time we move beyond beef!"

quotes.name: Armor Thrull
quotes.flavor:
"The worst thing about being a mercenary for the Ebon Hand is having to wear a dead thrull."
—Ivra Jursdotter

quotes.name: Wild Beastmaster
quotes.flavor: "When they covered the world in city, all they did was give themselves nowhere to run."

quotes.name: Weapon Rack
quotes.flavor: No weapon stays on the rack for long in the Burning Yard.

quotes.name: Unlucky Witness
quotes.flavor:
"I should have known you'd be involved in this somehow, Turk."
—Daredevil, Matt Murdock

quotes.name: Deduce
quotes.flavor:
"Do not overlook the unusual, for therein often lie the keys to the unknown."
—Alquist Proft's case journal

quotes.name: Skymark Roc
quotes.flavor:
"Try not to look guilty. Or delicious."
—Thorpe, street urchin

quotes.name: Cardboard Carapace
quotes.flavor: . . . that exciting . . . about . . .

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor:
"There's this house. A big old house, been empty for years, falling apart. Wester Drumlins, out by the estate."
—Sally Sparrow

quotes.name: Sharuum the Hegemon
quotes.flavor: To gain audience with the hegemon, one must bring a riddle she has not heard.

quotes.name: Seal of Cleansing
quotes.flavor:
"I am the purifier, the light that clears all shadows."
—Seal inscription

quotes.name: Curiosity
quotes.flavor: "Surely you know the joy of the hunt, my furry friend. My kind of hunt just takes a different form than yours."

quotes.name: Goblin Patrol
quotes.flavor:
"Take the sharp metal stick and make a lotta holes."
—Jula, goblin raider

quotes.name: Angelic Chorus
quotes.flavor: The harmony of the glorious is a dirge to the wicked.

quotes.name: Reckless Embermage
quotes.flavor: Many mages have been consumed by their work.

quotes.name: Acquire
quotes.flavor: Sometimes "innovation" means "stealing another's secret before anyone else can."

quotes.name: Rotting Mastodon
quotes.flavor: Mastodons became extinct long ago, but foul forces of the Gurmag Swamp sometimes animate their decaying remains. The Sultai happily exploit such creatures but consider them inferior to their own necromantic creations.

quotes.name: Loyal Sentry
quotes.flavor: His watch ends only when he does.

quotes.name: Yathan Tombguard
quotes.flavor: "Our khan would grant you clemency. She is naive. And unfortunately for you, she is also not here."

quotes.name: Chancellor Gorkon
quotes.flavor: "I offer a toast. The undiscovered country . . . the future."

quotes.name: Cache Raiders
quotes.flavor: What the current doesn't take, they do.

quotes.name: Rising of the Day
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Over the low hills the horns were sounding. Hastening down the long slopes were a thousand men on foot; their swords were in their hands.

quotes.name: Sulfur Falls
quotes.flavor: Shortly after the vault dwellers moved out, fire geckos moved in.

quotes.name: Whispersilk Cloak
quotes.flavor: Such cloaks are in high demand both by assassins and by those who fear them.

quotes.name: Ranger's Hawk
quotes.flavor: Swift eyes to scout the way ahead.

quotes.name: Sword of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

quotes.name: Furious Resistance
quotes.flavor:
"At least the Gateless rebels have ideals. Rakdos just mocks, defiles, and kills all we hold dear."
—Libuse, Boros sergeant

quotes.name: Temple of Epiphany
quotes.flavor:
"Hail the Children of the Stars!"
—Magus Lucea Kane

quotes.name: March of the Multitudes
quotes.flavor: "Our forces number more than the leaves of Vitu-Ghazi. Do not provoke us."

quotes.name: Karplusan Forest
quotes.flavor: Between jagged, snowcapped peaks, the dense bands of hardy evergreens provide the perfect cover for roving bands of orc and goblin raiders.

quotes.name: Counterspell
quotes.flavor: "How pathetic! To Doom, even your best efforts are an embarrassment!"

quotes.name: Mogg Sentry
quotes.flavor: Tortured with magic by their masters, the moggs are enflamed by the smell of sorcery.

quotes.name: Reign of Chaos
quotes.flavor:
"The Burning Isles are the home to a dozen lords who claim dominion. Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Spirit of the Spires
quotes.flavor: She breathes fair winds to tired griffins and lifts songbirds beyond the reach of stalking cats.

quotes.name: Itzquinth, Firstborn of Gishath
quotes.flavor:
"Dinosaurs have no concept of royalty, but they recognize the scent of the mightiest among them."
—Atla Palani, nest tender

quotes.name: Canopy Baloth
quotes.flavor:
"You can almost see it calculating—are we a tasty enough treat to risk the jump?"
—Samila, Murasa Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Dinosaur Egg
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: The Oltec revere dinosaurs as living remnants of the bygone Fourth Age.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Doppelgang
quotes.flavor:
"Suspect spotted at the Tin Street Market, Yescu Street entrance. And the Oak Street entrance. And somehow also in Lobar Alley!"
—Avult of the Foundway Associates

quotes.name: Bant Panorama
quotes.flavor: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

quotes.name: Muraganda Petroglyphs
quotes.flavor: Some mages forsake their scrolls and libraries to learn at the feet of ancient trees and sacred stones.

quotes.name: Colossal Might
quotes.flavor:
"Never corner a barbarian. You become the path of least resistance."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Croakid Amphibonaut
quotes.flavor:
"I designed the Astrotorium's jetpacks to be lightweight and inexpensive. Nobody mentioned reliable."
—Truss, chief engineer

quotes.name: Hanabi Blast
quotes.flavor: The most powerful of akki fire spells were developed at the cost of blood, toil, tears, sweat, and usually a nose or two.

quotes.name: Rats of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"These creatures offer new challenges in the scrutiny of entrails."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Ruinous Gremlin
quotes.flavor: City officials once sent twenty gleaming automatons to exterminate a nest of gremlins. They soon saw the error of their ways.

quotes.name: Lunar Frenzy
quotes.flavor: In the adrenaline-fueled chaos, she hadn't even felt the bite.

quotes.name: Slash of Light
quotes.flavor: The endless struggle that raged over two thousand years had ended, and peace prevailed once more.

quotes.name: Wickerbough Elder
quotes.flavor: "Living scarecrows make a mockery of the natural order. Dead ones make fine hats."

quotes.name: Ironclaw Orcs
quotes.flavor: Generations of genetic weeding have given rise to the deviously cowardly Ironclaw clan. To say that Orcs in general are vicious, depraved, and ignoble does not do justice to the Ironclaw.

quotes.name: Goblin Bird-Grabber
quotes.flavor: "I opens my mouth to catches the bugs!"

quotes.name: Leonin Armorguard
quotes.flavor: Well suited are the nacatl to a coat of steel and forge-tempered claws.

quotes.name: Wall of Tanglecord
quotes.flavor: Rootlike fibers travel far from Mirrodin's metallic forests, emerging from the crust to drink in the mana-infused sunlight.

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.flavor: "From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."

quotes.name: Monologue Tax
quotes.flavor:
"Your unsolicited words enrich us all. Please, continue."
—Yold, professor of cryptorelicology

quotes.name: Shed Weakness
quotes.flavor: To prepare for the Trial of Strength, nagas shed their old skin—and with it their scars, their doubts, and their fears.

quotes.name: Brawl
quotes.flavor: Anything can happen when patience is scarce and wine is abundant.

quotes.name: Water Wings
quotes.flavor: Luckily for the plummeting Johann, the hydroloft spell was one he had actually mastered.

quotes.name: The Vision and Scarlet Witch
quotes.flavor: No matter how many times they are disassembled, teleported, or possessed, their love always brings them back together.

quotes.name: Mirari
quotes.flavor:
"It offers you what you want, not what you need."
—Braids, dementia summoner

quotes.name: Razor Pendulum
quotes.flavor:
"Amazing thing, gravity. It seems to work every time."
—Telim'Tor

quotes.name: Word of Seizing
quotes.flavor: "Obey!"

quotes.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
quotes.flavor: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

quotes.name: Ivory Tower
quotes.flavor: Valuing scholarship above all else, the inhabitants of the Ivory Tower reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

quotes.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
quotes.flavor: It cuts through the Cosmos itself, carving new Omenpaths between the realms.

quotes.name: Dismal Backwater
quotes.flavor: Armageddon has become a site of holy pilgrimage for the Orks: a planet where the fighting never stops.

quotes.name: Prodigious Growth
quotes.flavor:
"Look how cute it is now!"
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor:
"Apalapucia, voted number two planet in the top ten greatest destinations for the discerning intergalactic traveler."
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Galecaster Colossus
quotes.flavor: Ground bones, broken glass, and splintered shipwrecks make up the sands of his shores.

quotes.name: Boros Guildgate
quotes.flavor: It promises protection to those in need and proclaims a warning to any who would threaten Ravnican law.

quotes.name: Ogre Battledriver
quotes.flavor: Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.

quotes.name: Vulshok Berserker
quotes.flavor: He experiences every emotion with passion and repays every slight with vengeance.

quotes.name: The Spot, Living Portal
quotes.flavor: Dr. Johnathon Ohnn had no problem breaking laws, physical or otherwise.

quotes.name: Drag Under
quotes.flavor: Some took to their boats to escape the unfolding nightmare. The remains of their vessels now litter the shores of Nephalia.

quotes.name: Bhaal's Invoker
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "The Lord of Murder has freed me from the shackles of mortal laws and gifted me with fire to carry out his will."

quotes.name: Ascended Lawmage
quotes.flavor: A lawmage's runic script is an act of governance given form: legislation written directly onto the air itself.

quotes.name: Kitesail Corsair
quotes.flavor: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

quotes.name: Nature's Lore
quotes.flavor: Druidcraft is a simple invocation to spirits of nature, promising a glimpse of nature's secrets.

quotes.name: Temple of the False God
quotes.flavor: Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.

quotes.name: Hornet Sting
quotes.flavor: It was only then—to his infinite sorrow—that Gork realized hornets don't make honey.

quotes.name: Roku's Mastery
quotes.flavor: Though Avatar Roku mastered all four elements, nothing seemed to quell a brewing conflict like a sun-sized ball of fire.

quotes.name: Skirsdag Cultist
quotes.flavor: "Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"

quotes.name: Kor Skyfisher
quotes.flavor: "Sometimes I snare the unexpected, but I know its purpose will be revealed in time."

quotes.name: Siege-Gang Commander
quotes.flavor: "Ready . . . uh . . . fire!"

quotes.name: Earthshaker
quotes.flavor: It scaled the Sokenzan Mountains in search of Kumano's secret. The mountain shook for two days, and the kami never returned.

quotes.name: Temple of Epiphany
quotes.flavor:
"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time."
—The Mouri

quotes.name: Cryptic Serpent
quotes.flavor: It slithers through the senses, constricting consciousness and poisoning perceptions.

quotes.name: Black Market
quotes.flavor: There's very little that merchants won't buy—and even less that wastelanders won't sell.

quotes.name: Frost Trickster
quotes.flavor: The most important skill in a Mage Tower match is keeping one's cool.

quotes.name: Acolyte Hybrid
quotes.flavor: Too obviously xenos in form to blend into human society, the acolytes haunt the dark places beneath industrial sprawls.

quotes.name: Live Long and Prosper
quotes.flavor:
"Logic is the beginning of wisdom, not the end."
—Mr. Spock

quotes.name: Geistcatcher's Rig
quotes.flavor: The rigs were outlawed except in Nephalia, where malign spirits are as plentiful as crazed inventors.

quotes.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
quotes.flavor: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

quotes.name: Child of the Volcano
quotes.flavor: It is a living eruption, unquenchable fury given form.

quotes.name: Abzan Battle Priest
quotes.flavor: "Wherever I walk, the ancestors walk too."

quotes.name: Talus Paladin
quotes.flavor: "Why fill pockets with gold when you can fill hearts with conviction?"

quotes.name: Skirsdag High Priest
quotes.flavor: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

quotes.name: Shore Snapper
quotes.flavor: Kathari, the sickly aven of Grixis, have learned that the corpses by the shoreline are more trap than treat.

quotes.name: Deep Analysis
quotes.flavor: "The specimen seems to be broken."

quotes.name: Goldhound
quotes.flavor: The staccato clatter of its metal claws on pavement is unmistakable.

quotes.name: Kopala, Warden of Waves
quotes.flavor: "I know these waters better than you know yourselves."

quotes.name: Snare Tactician
quotes.flavor:
"Our volleys don't aim to kill. Impair them and the ground will do the rest."
—Alux, Skysail defender

quotes.name: Invigorating Surge
quotes.flavor: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

quotes.name: Alms Collector
quotes.flavor: "There is no justice when some profit and others go without."

quotes.name: Flamekin Brawler
quotes.flavor: Cuando quema gente, se quedan quemados.

quotes.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
quotes.flavor: "Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of *compleation* is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."

quotes.name: The Meep
quotes.flavor: All hail the Meep.

quotes.name: Quag Sickness
quotes.flavor: The dread gases didn't kill Farbid. But as he lay in the muck, miserable and helpless, watching ghouls and rats advance on him, he wished they had.

quotes.name: Luminarch Aspirant
quotes.flavor: "Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!"

quotes.name: Archmage Emeritus
quotes.flavor: Some emeritus professors return from their wanderings periodically to share tales of the mystical wonders of Arcavios.

quotes.name: Hordeling Outburst
quotes.flavor:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

quotes.name: Stinging Shot
quotes.flavor: Initiates must train to resist the natural toxins they use as weapons.

quotes.name: Mask of Griselbrand
quotes.flavor: The legacy of evil lives on.

quotes.name: Enlarge
quotes.flavor: For Mittens, it was just another day at the beach.

quotes.name: Stone Haven Medic
quotes.flavor: "These days, soldiers never stick around long enough for a proper healing. They just want me to knit them up so they can hurry back to the fight."

quotes.name: Return to Dust
quotes.flavor: "Designation: *Vor'cha*-class attack cruiser. Length: 481.32 meters. Hull: Duranium alloy. Threat assessment: 1.1%."

quotes.name: Jolly Gerbils
quotes.flavor: "With all the chaos going around, we thought it might be the perfect time to take a break and have a nice picnic. Would you like to join us?"

quotes.name: Lightning Javelin
quotes.flavor: The harpies descended without mercy upon Akros, only to find their attack put them within range of the javelineers.

quotes.name: Fracture
quotes.flavor:
「敵の力を元から断つこと。そうすれば、相手の戦意を削ぐことになるでしょう。」
――シルバークイルの学部長、エムブローズ

quotes.name: Cetacean Ops
quotes.flavor: Various sapient whale species serve in Starfleet as navigators, scientists, and explorers.

quotes.name: Fireblade Artist
quotes.flavor: "Let's find out what kind of audience you are. Festive? Fearless?"

quotes.name: Micromancer
quotes.flavor: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

quotes.name: Pay No Heed
quotes.flavor: "My course is before me. There is nothing behind me."

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, so you're my replacements. Huh. A dandy and a clown. Have you done anything?"
—The First Doctor

quotes.name: Gleaming Splendor
quotes.flavor: Bilbo had heard tell and sing of Dragon-hoards before, but the splendor, the lust, the glory of such treasure had never yet come home to him.

quotes.name: Arasta of the Endless Web
quotes.flavor: Her webs, spun from her own hair, reach from Nyx to the mortal world and even into the Underworld.

quotes.name: Malamet War Scribe
quotes.flavor: The glyph is mightier than the sword.

quotes.name: Fading Hope
quotes.flavor: "At least I won't become one of . . . those things."

quotes.name: Transgress the Mind
quotes.flavor:
"Fear of the unknown can be a wonderfully innocent thing, relatively speaking."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

quotes.name: Unmoored Ego
quotes.flavor: A well-chosen word can restore a mind or snap its tethers.

quotes.name: Traverse the Outlands
quotes.flavor: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: Volrath has bred them to fear only him. Are they charging into battle, or merely fleeing his wrath?

quotes.name: Join Forces
quotes.flavor:
"Okay—you take the sixteen ragers and the hulk on the right. I'll take the ten defilers and the plaguelord on the left. Ready?"
—Danitha, to Radha

quotes.name: Rosheen Meanderer
quotes.flavor: Night after night, Rosheen babbled about a bygone sunlit world, her every word dismissed as a madwoman's ravings.

quotes.name: Deadly Complication
quotes.flavor: Teysa's security was unrivaled. Etrata was locked up. Kaya was left with nothing but multiplying questions... and a dead friend.

quotes.name: Dowsing Shaman
quotes.flavor: He combs the streets looking for the lost light, the discarded enigmas of the city.

quotes.name: Codsworth, Handy Helper
quotes.flavor: "Proud to serve!"

quotes.name: Cathar Commando
quotes.flavor: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

quotes.name: Tezzeret's Betrayal
quotes.flavor:
"You can't hope to comprehend the plans that are in motion."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Allied Strategies
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: Each commander looked at the others and wondered who would be first to break the alliance.

quotes.name: Seaside Citadel
quotes.flavor: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Vindicator
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor:
"Behold your inevitable defeat."
—Elesh Norn

quotes.name: Grisly Spectacle
quotes.flavor:
"Watch people flock to a murder scene. Then tell me we're not all a little sick in the head."
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

quotes.name: Dragonspeaker Shaman
quotes.flavor: "We speak the dragons' language of flame and rage. They speak our language of fury and honor. Together we shall weave a tale of destruction without equal."

quotes.name: War Effort
quotes.flavor:
Community is strength.
—Tenet of the Decree of Thunder

quotes.name: Refute Destiny
quotes.flavor: Quandrix believed in finding the equations of the natural world. Hexhaven disrupted the pattern of existence.

quotes.name: Devils' Playground
quotes.flavor:
"The city is overrun. I would say burn it to the ground, but that won't be necessary."
—Inquisitor Delmund

quotes.name: Homarid Explorer
quotes.flavor:
"Homarids spread northward from Sarpadia as the climate cooled, raiding coastal settlements for supplies."
—*Time of Ice*

quotes.name: Scroll of Avacyn
quotes.flavor: Words to bless the eye that reads them, telling of a future beyond the reach of fear.

quotes.name: Scavenging Ooze
quotes.flavor: In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.

quotes.name: Lifeblood
quotes.flavor:
"Foolish wizard! As you tap the power of your lofty keep, so grows my strength."
—Malvern Xelionos, *Letters*

quotes.name: Biowaste Blob
quotes.flavor:
"The Simic will be fined for contaminating the waterways. In the meantime, seize that blob!"
—Arrester Polgar

quotes.name: Sphere Grid
quotes.flavor: To activate nodes, you must use spheres.

quotes.name: Durable Coilbug
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen them survive lava, trampling, and a moloch's digestive system. They just roll out and get on with their lives!"
—Gannet, Skysail zoologist

quotes.name: Blood Moon
quotes.flavor: Heavy light flooded across the landscape, cloaking everything in deep crimson.

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor:
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong."
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Mirkwood Bats
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The enemy has many spies and many ways of hearing."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Vedalken Humiliator
quotes.flavor: "And who will stop me? You?"

quotes.name: Eyes in the Skies
quotes.flavor:
"What root and branch cannot reach, our winged friends will attend to."
—Zunak, Selesnya strategist

quotes.name: Watchful Radstag
quotes.flavor: Don't mistake timidness for defenselessness.

quotes.name: Rampaging Baloths
quotes.flavor:
"When the land is angry, so are they."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Dualcaster Mage
quotes.flavor: "It has been my experience that disasters like to strike in pairs."

quotes.name: Angelic Protector
quotes.flavor:
"My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Tombstone, Career Criminal
quotes.flavor: "I told you years ago, stay out of my way and you'll live a long, long time. That was good advice then, and it's good advice now."

quotes.name: Balduvian War-Makers
quotes.flavor:
"Those mewling Barbarians will cower before my righteous steel!"
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Fog Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Viridian Revel
quotes.flavor: Some delights are best enjoyed in company.

quotes.name: Tangled Colony
quotes.flavor: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

quotes.name: Volrath's Stronghold
quotes.flavor: The seed of a world's evil.

quotes.name: Relentless Assault
quotes.flavor:
"Flog and Squee / Up the tree / See the army / Flee, flee, flee."
—Goblin nursery rhyme/war cry

quotes.name: Grapeshot
quotes.flavor: As the mother rewrites the fabric of reality, so too does the son.

quotes.name: Wurmcoil Engine
quotes.flavor: In case of abject terror: cover head and hope for best.

quotes.name: Anger
quotes.flavor: A is for Agility. A measure of your overall finesse and reflexes. It affects the number of action points in V.A.T.S. and your ability to sneak.

quotes.name: Seaside Citadel
quotes.flavor: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

quotes.name: Ixidor, Reality Sculptor
quotes.flavor: "Reality has exiled me. I am no longer bound by its laws."

quotes.name: Conspiracy
quotes.flavor:
"Those who don't stand with us, stand against us."
—Deimos

quotes.name: Ruin Crab
quotes.flavor: 探検家にとっては、かけがえのない財宝。カニにとっては、頼れる我が家。

quotes.name: Snapping Voidcraw
quotes.flavor: Once considered a delicacy, turtle soup is no longer served in Nephalia's inns.

quotes.name: Exploding Barrel
quotes.flavor:
"Good news, dudes! It says it's inflammable!"
—Michelangelo

quotes.name: Shu Soldier-Farmers
quotes.flavor: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

quotes.name: Mary Jane Watson
quotes.flavor: Charismatic and confident, Mary Jane was born for the limelight.

quotes.name: Harnessed Snubhorn
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: Survivors put the strength of former war mounts to good use clearing the rubble of Orazca.

quotes.name: Capricious Efreet
quotes.flavor: "You wish for great destruction? It is done, my master."

quotes.name: Endless Scream
quotes.flavor:
"I have made Crovax weep; now I will make him scream. The pain will not end, but will bind him to me."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Isolated Chapel
quotes.flavor: This is the Sealed Gate... Beyond there is the esper world.

quotes.name: Battlefield Forge
quotes.flavor:
"In the morning, I shall ride to Edoras to the gathering of the Mark."
—Théoden

quotes.name: Rhystic Syphon
quotes.flavor: Jamuraan wizards are linked together by magic, a bond that only the wicked dare exploit.

quotes.name: Kalastria Highborn
quotes.flavor: Each of Malakir's great families boasts a contingent of nulls appropriate to its rank in society.

quotes.name: Silence the Echo
quotes.flavor: The Vraska who had never known pain could not comprehend the unyielding will of the Vraska who had known too much.

quotes.name: Vedalken Engineer
quotes.flavor: Art is unknown to the vedalken—for them, all creations must serve a purpose.

quotes.name: Razortooth Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Men and rats both hunger: we for our playthings; they, for us."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Feral Animist
quotes.flavor: He chanted over a pot of boiling blood and honey. His brain buzzed like a nest of hornets, and his muscles rippled with the might of the bear.

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Brassclaw Orcs
quotes.flavor:
"Modern Sarpadia's swarming with thrulls. It's a testament to the orcs that they've survived there so long."
—Elbieta, Argivian scholar

quotes.name: Panharmonicon
quotes.flavor: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

quotes.name: Merchant Scroll
quotes.flavor: A rare find, suitable for the most discerning collector.

quotes.name: Basic Conjuration
quotes.flavor: "I made that! It's mine! Did you see that?"

quotes.name: Dazzling Reflection
quotes.flavor:
"The light of a felidar's horns can give even an Eldrazi pause."
—Zarra, lullmage

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor: The wise always keep an ear open to the whispers of power.

quotes.name: Fall of the Hammer
quotes.flavor: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

quotes.name: Crawling Barrens
quotes.flavor: Zendikar is restless.

quotes.name: Commander Eesha
quotes.flavor: "War glides on the simplest updrafts while peace struggles against hurricane winds. It is the way of the world. It must change."

quotes.name: Blackblade Reforged
quotes.flavor: It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.

quotes.name: Thousand-Year Storm
quotes.flavor: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

quotes.name: Underrealm Lich
quotes.flavor: "You've strayed, overworlder."

quotes.name: Inti, Seneschal of the Sun
quotes.flavor: "I'm a Kirk-style free spirit!"

quotes.name: Surprise, Nerd!
quotes.flavor: Designed by players at MagicCon Chicago 2025.

quotes.name: Turbulent Crater
quotes.flavor:
"The Theorist swears this Multiverse will be free of suffering, but part of me wonders if he just plans on hiding it better."
—Tam, field notes

quotes.name: Pair o' Dice Lost
quotes.flavor: The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.

quotes.name: Zealous Persecution
quotes.flavor:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

quotes.name: Knight of Dusk
quotes.flavor:
Fall like night upon the foe.
—Motto of the Knights of Dusk

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: It treads on feet of coals and strikes with the force of a volcano.

quotes.name: Lightning Helix
quotes.flavor: Though less well-known than its army of soldiers, the Boros Legion's mage-priests are as respected by the innocent as they are hated by the ghosts of the guilty.

quotes.name: Drowned Catacomb
quotes.flavor:
"The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all."
—Ramo

quotes.name: Verdant Force
quotes.flavor: The bower shuddered. The stillness broke. The scurf shifted, and a being emerged from the flowers and ferns.

quotes.name: Vampire Gourmand
quotes.flavor: "He asked me if I wanted to come in for a bite to eat. Who am I to turn down a stranger's kindness?"

quotes.name: Cloudchaser Eagle
quotes.flavor: Most eagles hunt small animals. The cloudchasers hunt magic.

quotes.name: Reef Shaman
quotes.flavor: With one gesture, she can render a thousand years of navigational charts obsolete.

quotes.name: Thunderheads
quotes.flavor: The clouds grew thick, and then they grew teeth.

quotes.name: Masked Admirers
quotes.flavor: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

quotes.name: Stoic Ephemera
quotes.flavor: "Life is fleeting, and so is death. Only the oath is eternal."
